Bardstown Bourbon Company Origin Series.profile: Honey, apricot, vanilla, caramel, wheat bread, and oak.

Buffalo Trace.profile: Caramel, vanilla, light cherry, brown sugar, and soft oak.

Chattanooga Whiskey 111.profile: Honey malt, caramel, cocoa, baking spice, oak, and dried fruit.

David Nicholson 1843.profile: Honey, vanilla, oak, caramel, wheat bread, and spice.

Maker’s Mark Cellar Aged 2025 Release.profile: Aged oak, baking spices, brown sugar, black forest cake, mixed berry pie, fudge brownie, marshmallow, dark cinnamon, and dried tobacco.
Maker’s Mark Cellar Aged 2025 Release.description: A limited annual Maker's Mark Cellar Aged release blending 11, 13, and 14 year wheated bourbons.
Maker’s Mark Cellar Aged 2025 Release.verdict_notes: Excellent at MSRP for a mature wheated bourbon. Above fair range, make sure you specifically want Cellar Aged and not just a strong cask-strength Maker's pour.
Maker’s Mark Cellar Aged 2025 Release.name: Maker’s Mark Cellar Aged 2025 Release

finish: creamy mouthfeel transitioning to dry spice

Maker’s Mark Cellar Aged 2025 Release.summary: Maker’s Mark Cellar Aged 2025 is a limited annual release blending 11, 13, and 14 year wheated bourbons, finished in a temperature-controlled limestone cellar. Bottled at 112.9 proof, it delivers a rich balance of confectionery sweetness and mature oak with a long, spice-driven finish.

Maker's Mark Cask Strength.profile: Vanilla, caramel, red fruit, baking spice, wheat sweetness, and oak.
Maker's Mark Cask Strength.description: A cask strength version of Maker's Mark with more body and spice.
Maker's Mark Cask Strength.verdict_notes: Often the smarter wheated bourbon buy when allocated bottles are marked up.

Michter's 10 Year Bourbon.profile: Toffee, oak, cherry, vanilla, leather, tobacco, and baking spice.
Michter's 10 Year Bourbon.description: A limited 10-year single barrel bourbon from Michter's.
Michter's 10 Year Bourbon.verdict_notes: Excellent bottle, but pricing is usually collector territory.

Michter's US*1 Bourbon.profile: Caramel, vanilla, dried fruit, toasted oak, and baking spice.
Michter's US*1 Bourbon.description: A small batch bourbon from Michter's.
Michter's US*1 Bourbon.verdict_notes: Polished and accessible, though not always a value play.

New Riff Bottled in Bond Bourbon.profile: Rye spice, vanilla, orange, oak, mint, and caramel.
New Riff Bottled in Bond Bourbon.description: A bottled-in-bond high-rye bourbon from New Riff.
New Riff Bottled in Bond Bourbon.verdict_notes: Solid modern craft bourbon with honest proof and structure.

New Riff Single Barrel Bourbon.profile: Rye spice, caramel, mint, orange peel, vanilla, and oak.
New Riff Single Barrel Bourbon.description: A single barrel bourbon from New Riff.
New Riff Single Barrel Bourbon.verdict_notes: Can be excellent if you like high-rye spice and barrel variation.

Old Elk Bourbon.profile: Honey, malt, vanilla, caramel, orange, and light oak.
Old Elk Bourbon.description: A high-malt bourbon from Old Elk.
Old Elk Bourbon.verdict_notes: Smooth and approachable, with a softer profile than proof hunters may want.

Old Elk Wheated Bourbon.profile: Honey, vanilla, wheat bread, caramel, fruit, and oak.
Old Elk Wheated Bourbon.description: A wheated bourbon from Old Elk.
Old Elk Wheated Bourbon.verdict_notes: Good if you like gentle sweetness and do not mind the premium.

Old Ezra 7 Year.profile: Caramel, oak, spice, vanilla, dark fruit, and heat.
Old Ezra 7 Year.description: A 7-year barrel strength bourbon from Lux Row.
Old Ezra 7 Year.verdict_notes: Solid barrel-strength pour, especially below triple digits.

Old Forester 100 Proof.profile: Banana bread, caramel, spice, oak, vanilla, and pepper.
Old Forester 100 Proof.description: A 100-proof Old Forester bourbon with classic Brown-Forman fruit and spice.
Old Forester 100 Proof.verdict_notes: Excellent value bottle with cocktail backbone.

Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond.profile: Caramel, banana, oak, clove, vanilla, and dark sugar.
Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond.description: The bottled-in-bond release from Old Forester's Whiskey Row lineup.
Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond.verdict_notes: Good bottle, though competition at the price is strong.

Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky.profile: Chocolate, marshmallow, caramel, toasted oak, vanilla, and baking spice.
Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky.description: A heavily finished Old Forester bourbon with dessert-like oak sweetness.
Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky.verdict_notes: Great if you want sweet toasted oak; maybe too rich for some palates.

Old Forester 1920 Prohibition Style.profile: Dark cherry, banana, caramel, oak, chocolate, and spice.
Old Forester 1920 Prohibition Style.description: A high-proof Old Forester release inspired by Prohibition-era proofing.
Old Forester 1920 Prohibition Style.verdict_notes: A beloved shelf bottle for proof and flavor density.

Old Forester 86 Proof.profile: Banana, caramel, oak, vanilla, baking spice, and brown sugar.
Old Forester 86 Proof.verdict_notes: Good mixer and casual pour; the 100 proof version is usually the better buy.

Old Forester Birthday Bourbon.profile: Caramel, oak, dark fruit, banana, spice, vanilla, and cocoa.
similar: Four Roses Limited Edition Small Batch
Old Forester Birthday Bourbon.description: An annual limited Old Forester release.
Old Forester Birthday Bourbon.verdict_notes: Year matters. Retail is a celebration; secondary is a negotiation with your wallet.

Old Grand-Dad 114.profile: Peanut brittle, rye spice, caramel, orange, oak, and heat.
Old Grand-Dad 114.verdict_notes: One of the classic budget proof plays.

Old Grand-Dad Bonded.profile: Peanut, orange peel, rye spice, caramel, oak, and pepper.
Old Grand-Dad Bonded.description: A budget bottled-in-bond bourbon using Beam's high-rye recipe.
Old Grand-Dad Bonded.verdict_notes: Great value. Not fancy, but it knows its job.

Old Rip Van Winkle 10 Year.profile: Caramel, cherry, vanilla, oak, cinnamon, and soft wheat sweetness.
Old Rip Van Winkle 10 Year.description: A 10-year wheated bourbon bottled at 107 proof.
Old Rip Van Winkle 10 Year.verdict_notes: A dream at retail, but the market usually treats it like a trophy.

Pappy Van Winkle 15 Year.profile: Deep caramel, old oak, cherry, leather, vanilla, baking spice, and mature tobacco.
Pappy Van Winkle 15 Year.description: A legendary 15-year wheated bourbon from the Van Winkle lineup.
Pappy Van Winkle 15 Year.verdict_notes: Fantastic bourbon, but almost never rational at collector pricing.

Peerless Double Oak Bourbon.profile: Chocolate, toasted oak, maple, caramel, vanilla, and spice.
Peerless Double Oak Bourbon.description: A double-oaked bourbon from Kentucky Peerless.
Peerless Double Oak Bourbon.verdict_notes: Rich and expressive if you love toasted oak.

Peerless Small Batch Bourbon.profile: Caramel, oak, citrus, spice, cocoa, and sweet grain.
similar: Bardstown Bourbon Company Origin Series Bourbon
Peerless Small Batch Bourbon.description: A sweet mash bourbon from Kentucky Peerless.
Peerless Small Batch Bourbon.verdict_notes: Quality is there, but the price asks you to care.

Penelope Architect.profile: Toasted oak, vanilla, caramel, baking spice, fruit, and cocoa.
Penelope Architect.description: A French oak stave-finished bourbon from Penelope.
Penelope Architect.verdict_notes: Worth trying if you like oak-finished sweetness.

Penelope Barrel Strength.profile: Caramel, vanilla, fruit, spice, oak, and honeyed grain.
Penelope Barrel Strength.description: A barrel strength bourbon from Penelope.
Penelope Barrel Strength.verdict_notes: Good modern bottle when priced like a drinker, not a trophy.

Rebel 100.profile: Honey, vanilla, wheat bread, caramel, light oak, and pepper.
Rebel 100.description: A budget wheated bourbon from Lux Row.
Rebel 100.verdict_notes: Good inexpensive wheater and cocktail bottle.

Rebel Cask Strength.profile: Caramel, cinnamon, wheat sweetness, oak, vanilla, and heat.
Rebel Cask Strength.description: A cask strength wheated bourbon from Rebel.
Rebel Cask Strength.verdict_notes: Good proofy wheater if the store keeps it honest.

Remus Repeal Reserve.profile: Cherry, oak, rye spice, caramel, vanilla, leather, and dark fruit.
Remus Repeal Reserve.description: A limited annual bourbon blend from Ross & Squibb.
Remus Repeal Reserve.verdict_notes: Often a serious blend; batch reputation matters.

Russell's Reserve 10 Year.profile: Caramel, oak, vanilla, cherry, leather, and gentle Turkey spice.
Russell's Reserve 10 Year.description: A 10-year bourbon from Wild Turkey's Russell's Reserve line.
Russell's Reserve 10 Year.verdict_notes: Good age-stated shelf bottle with calm proof.

Russell's Reserve 13 Year.profile: Caramel, dark cherry, old oak, leather, vanilla, spice, and tobacco.
Russell's Reserve 13 Year.verdict_notes: Outstanding mature Turkey profile, but the market knows it.

Russell’s Reserve 15 Year Bourbon (2024).profile: Cherry, caramel, oak, baking spice, dark fruit, molasses, coffee, tobacco, aged oak, dark cocoa, and long lingering spice.
Russell’s Reserve 15 Year Bourbon (2024).description: A limited 2024 15-year Russell’s Reserve bourbon bottled non-chill filtered at 117.2 proof.
Russell’s Reserve 15 Year Bourbon (2024).verdict_notes: A premium mature Turkey bottle. Strong at MSRP, but secondary pricing gets serious fast.
Russell’s Reserve 15 Year Bourbon (2024).name: Russell’s Reserve 15 Year Bourbon (2024)
Russell’s Reserve 15 Year Bourbon (2024).summary: Russell’s Reserve 15 Year Bourbon (RR15) is a limited 2024 release bottled at 117.2 proof, showcasing the Russell family’s signature Wild Turkey profile elevated by extended aging. It delivers bold cherry-forward sweetness, rich oak integration, and deep spice, making it a landmark release for the brand.

Russell's Reserve Single Barrel.profile: Caramel, charred oak, vanilla, cherry, leather, and Turkey spice.
Russell's Reserve Single Barrel.description: A robust Wild Turkey single barrel bourbon with proof and depth.
Russell's Reserve Single Barrel.verdict_notes: Usually a great drinker's bottle, especially store picks.

Rye Fidelity Bottled in Bond.profile: Aged sweetness, light spice, balanced sweet and spicy aromas, aged oak, straightforward rye flavor, spice-forward finish, and charred oak.
similar: New Riff Bottled in Bond Rye
Rye Fidelity Bottled in Bond.description: A limited 100 proof, 6+ year bottled-in-bond straight rye from Broad Branch Distillery in Winston-Salem, North Carolina.
Rye Fidelity Bottled in Bond.verdict_notes: Pricing data is not set yet. Treat it as a limited craft bottled-in-bond rye and compare against New Riff, Pikesville, and other 100-proof rye options.
Rye Fidelity Bottled in Bond.name: Rye Fidelity Bottled in Bond
Rye Fidelity Bottled in Bond.summary: Rye Fidelity Bottled in Bond is a 100 proof, 6+ year straight rye from Broad Branch Distillery. It delivers a balanced 'Goldilocks' profile of sweet, spice, and oak, leaning approachable rather than bold, with a quick, spice-forward finish.

Smoke Wagon Small Batch.profile: Caramel, dried fruit, vanilla, spice, oak, and toasted sugar.
similar: Bardstown Bourbon Company Origin Series Bourbon
Smoke Wagon Small Batch.description: A Nevada-bottled small batch bourbon brand built around sourced whiskey.
Smoke Wagon Small Batch.verdict_notes: Good modern profile; price check against local competition.

Smoke Wagon Uncut Unfiltered.profile: Dark fruit, caramel, cinnamon, oak, vanilla, and heat.
Smoke Wagon Uncut Unfiltered.description: A cask strength Smoke Wagon bourbon release.
Smoke Wagon Uncut Unfiltered.verdict_notes: Popular for a reason, but batches and prices vary.

Stagg.profile: Dark cherry, brown sugar, chocolate, oak, tobacco, heat, and dense spice.
similar: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Barrel Proof
Stagg.description: A bold barrel-proof Buffalo Trace bourbon with heavy flavor and serious heat.
Stagg.verdict_notes: A monster pour when priced fairly. Secondary numbers can get silly fast.

Weller 12 Year.profile: Soft caramel, vanilla, oak, red fruit, honey, and gentle spice.
Weller 12 Year.description: A 12-year wheated bourbon from Buffalo Trace.
Weller 12 Year.verdict_notes: Lovely pour, but proof and hype often make the shelf price hard to justify.

Weller Antique 107.profile: Cherry, cinnamon, caramel, vanilla, oak, and a punchy wheated sweetness.
Weller Antique 107.description: A high-proof wheated bourbon from Buffalo Trace with a big sweet-spice profile.
Weller Antique 107.verdict_notes: Excellent pour near MSRP. Past fair drinker pricing, the hype starts doing a lot of the work.

Weller Full Proof.profile: Cherry syrup, vanilla, cinnamon, caramel, oak, and dense wheat sweetness.
Weller Full Proof.description: A non-chill-filtered wheated bourbon bottled at entry proof.
Weller Full Proof.verdict_notes: Excellent if you land it fairly; quickly becomes collector-priced.

Wild Turkey 101.profile: Caramel, vanilla, orange peel, cinnamon, oak, and rye spice.
Wild Turkey 101.description: A classic 101-proof bourbon with punch and value.
Wild Turkey 101.verdict_notes: A forever recommendation for a house bottle.

Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon.style: Limited barrel proof Kentucky straight bourbon
Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon.profile: Toasted caramel, tobacco, toffee, oak, orange creamsicle, stewed apple, vanilla bean, cherry, cola, brown sugar, root beer, leather, and clove.
similar: King of Kentucky Small Batch Bourbon
Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon.description: A limited 2025 Master’s Keep release blending 10- and 16-year-old Wild Turkey bourbons, bottled at 118 proof.
Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon.verdict_notes: At MSRP this is a strong premium Wild Turkey buy. Above fair range, make sure the Master’s Keep story and mature Turkey profile are what you want.
Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon.name: Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon
Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon.summary: Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Beacon is a limited 2025 release blending 10- and 16-year-old bourbons, bottled at 118 proof. Created by Eddie and Bruce Russell, it represents a generational collaboration and potentially the final chapter in the Master’s Keep series, delivering a bold, mature profile of caramel, tobacco, fruit, and spice.

Wild Turkey Rare Breed.profile: Caramel, orange peel, oak, cinnamon, vanilla, and bold rye spice.
Wild Turkey Rare Breed.description: A non-chill-filtered barrel proof bourbon that is widely loved for value.
Wild Turkey Rare Breed.verdict_notes: One of the easiest recommendations in bourbon if you like proof.

William Larue Weller.profile: Dark cherry, molasses, oak, tobacco, vanilla, leather, and huge wheated richness.
William Larue Weller.description: The barrel-proof wheated bourbon in Buffalo Trace Antique Collection.
William Larue Weller.verdict_notes: World-class bottle; judge the price with your heart safely locked away.

William Larue Weller 2025.profile: Caramel, vanilla, oak, wheat sweetness, brown sugar, toffee, spice, creamy sweet oak, and long finish.
William Larue Weller 2025.description: The 2025 William Larue Weller release from the Buffalo Trace Antique Collection, a 14-year barrel proof wheated bourbon.
William Larue Weller 2025.verdict_notes: BTAC wheated royalty. MSRP is a unicorn; secondary is almost always emotional terrain.
William Larue Weller 2025.name: William Larue Weller 2025
William Larue Weller 2025.summary: William Larue Weller 2025 (WLW 2025) is a 14-year, 129 proof barrel-proof wheated bourbon from the Buffalo Trace Antique Collection. It delivers caramel, vanilla, oak, brown sugar, toffee, wheat sweetness, and a long creamy finish.

Woodford Reserve.profile: Dried fruit, vanilla, orange, cocoa, oak, and spice.
Woodford Reserve.description: A polished Kentucky bourbon from Brown-Forman.
Woodford Reserve.verdict_notes: Reliable and approachable, especially for mixed company.

Woodford Reserve Double Oaked.profile: Chocolate, toasted marshmallow, caramel, oak, vanilla, and maple.
Woodford Reserve Double Oaked.description: A twice-barreled Woodford Reserve with a sweet toasted profile.
Woodford Reserve Double Oaked.verdict_notes: Great dessert pour if the price stays grounded.

Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon.style: 8 year barrel proof Kentucky straight bourbon
Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon.profile: Dark caramel, oak, ripe cherry, confectioners sugar, cinnamon, butterscotch, dark fruit, charred oak, mocha, grain, warm spice, and cinnamon candy.
Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon.description: An 8-year, 110 proof limited Yellowstone bourbon from Limestone Branch Distillery, inspired by historic back-bar decanters.
Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon.verdict_notes: At MSRP this is a strong limited-release Yellowstone buy. Above fair range, compare against other 110-proof limited Kentucky bourbons.
Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon.name: Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon
Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon.summary: Yellowstone Recollection Bourbon is an 8-year, 110 proof limited release from Limestone Branch Distillery. Inspired by historic back-bar decanters, it delivers a balanced profile of caramel, dark fruit, oak, and spice with a warm, cherry-accented finish.
